# AgentsRE

SRE-grade monitoring for AI agents: synthetic canary checks + production
telemetry fused into one alert stream, with baseline regression alerting
(latency, cost, eval score, refusal rate, error rate).

## Docs

- [Synthetic checks](docs/checks.md): the agent runtime, assertions, scheduling
- [Production ingest](docs/ingest.md): envelope, OTLP, Langfuse-compat
- [Alerting](docs/alerting.md): baselines, regression policy, channels
- [Operations](docs/ops.md): platform self-monitoring, admin API, cost by feature
- [SDK and API](docs/api.md): REST surface, checks-as-code, Agent Skills
- [Billing](docs/billing.md): plans, metered usage
- [Helicone migration](docs/migrate-helicone.md): one-shot import

## Quick facts

- Product: agentsre — Agent SRE
- API base: https://api.agentsre.dev (auth: `Authorization: Bearer <api-key>`)
- All bodies JSON. Errors: `{"error": "..."}`
- A "feature" is any user-facing agent capability you monitor (e.g. checkout, support)
- Every Run (synthetic or production) carries cost fields from day one
